answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id fund its own vault of escrowed work before its vote counts. A fresh id must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun, and post a locked deposit. Attesters stake collateral and forfeit it if they vouch for a fake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets may wander the ledger like umber sediment: plentiful, but weightless at the ballot, while honest ids compound audited trust epoch after epoch.
